title.zh-CN: For Sale：买到最好的房子，为什么还可能少赚？
title.en: For Sale: Why Can Buying the Best House Leave You with Less?

summary.zh-CN: 用三个可复算局面，分析退拍如何改变后手的所得、同时出售为何取决于相对名次，以及现金变成一次性手牌后的终局取舍。
summary.en: Three worked situations examine how passing changes others’ fallback, why simultaneous sales depend on relative rank, and how turning cash into cards affects final wealth.
